description: This file defines a React component for rendering polygon layers using deck.gl in a Superset visualization plugin. It includes functions for creating layers, handling tooltips, and managing viewport adjustments, with support for various color schemes and user interactions.

classes.name: DeckGLPolygon
classes.description: React component for rendering a deck.gl polygon layer with viewport management and tooltip support.

methods.name: getElevation
methods.description: Calculates elevation for a polygon based on its color opacity and elevation property.

methods.name: defaultTooltipGenerator
methods.description: Generates tooltip content for polygons, displaying name, category, and metric information.

methods.name: getLayer
methods.description: Creates and returns a deck.gl PolygonLayer configured with data, colors, and interaction handlers.

methods.name: getPoints
methods.description: Extracts polygon points from data features.
